top_signals.title: IMF warns bond yields could see a 'disorderly' spike as debt, inflation risks worsen
top_signals.summary: The IMF says risks in the government bond market have worsened and that yields could jump sharply and disorderly.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: BNP Paribas' Mateos y Lago on the Global Economy
top_signals.summary: Isabelle Mateos y Lago, Group Chief Economist at BNP Paribas, says the global economy remains resilient, but faces strains from rising interest rates and energy shocks. She speaks on the sidelines of the IMF-World Bank Annual Meetings in Bangkok. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: State Street Investment Management's CIO on Markets
top_signals.summary: Lori Heinel, Global CIO at State Street Investment Management, says AI is a transformative technology with long-term benefits that could spread across the global economy. She speaks on the sidelines of the IMF-World Bank Annual Meetings in Bangkok. (Source: Bloomberg)
